title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements — Price of a Summit Gold Status Award in Company Points
content:
**Price statement.** A Summit Gold status award redeemed from the company points of a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement is priced at the Gold award price: the tier's Summit Gold status-award points. The Gold award price is charged in full, and the points redeemed for the award are that price, a whole number of points.

### Statement in parts

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| Gold award price | the tier's Summit Gold status-award points |
| Part of the price charged | the whole price |
| Points redeemed | the price so charged, in whole points |

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

On a tier whose Summit Gold status-award points are 3800, the Gold award price is 3800 points, it is charged in full, and the redemption entry carries 3800 points. The agreement's point balance must cover the whole of it.
